To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the yield ratios of deuterons and protons in heavy-ion collisions are governed by the volume and temperature of the system and the apparent entropy extracted from these ratios is independent of target-projectile combinations.
The ratio d like / plike is a measure of the degree of thermalization in heavy-ion reactions.

the entropy production in heavy-ion reaction can be quantified in terms of the ratio of deuteron-like to proton-like cluster yields and it is independent of the target and projectile combinations and the bombarding energy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of entropy and cluster production in heavy ion collisions.
the entropy production in medium-energy heavy-ion collisions.
the production and evolution of clusters in heavy-ion collisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the apparent entropy is a function of the number of participants and the bombarding energy, and the apparent entropy per participant increases with the number of participants.
the apparent entropy production is a function of the total number of participants and the volume of the reaction region.
the yield ratio of deuteron-to-protonlike cluster is a very useful observable for the study of entropy production and thermodynamical equilibrium of nuclear matter in heavy-ion collisions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the apparent entropy production is a good measure for the degree of thermodynamic equilibrium in heavy-ion collisions.
the entropy production and its relation to d like / plike ratio are not governed by the thermodynamical equilibrium, but by the universality characteristics of the system.
the entropy produced in medium energy heavy ion collisions is governed by the reaction volume and is independent of the system under study.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the apparent entropy extracted from d like / plike ratios is not the same as the entropy produced in the system and it is not the same for all systems.
the apparent entropy extracted from yield ratios of deutero-like to proton-like clusters is governed by the reaction volume and is independent of the target–projectile combination.
the entropy production in heavy-ion reactions is a measure of the degree of equilibration of the system.
